commit_message:
fix: use peviitor's own canonical company name, not ANAF's, for job/company records

Fleet-wide propagation of a real bug found via a live report (Hochland
scraper showing 0 results when filtered by company on peviitor.ro, despite
free-text search finding its jobs fine). See Brewtality-3-16 commit ce99d17
for the full root-cause writeup.

Queries peviitor by the uppercased legal name (its search is exact,
case-sensitive) and, when a record is found, uses its company field as the
canonical name for job records and future company-core upserts instead of
ANAF's freshly fetched name.
